attr.title: YTC
attr.desc: A native, controller-driven YouTube client for handhelds. Browse, search, and watch YouTube with its own anonymous client - no login, no yt-dlp, no browser.
attr.desc_md:
**YTC (Your Tube Client)** is a native, controller-driven YouTube client built for Linux handhelds. It talks to YouTube through its own anonymous Innertube client (no login, no yt-dlp, no Python, no browser) and plays video through a bundled render-only libmpv + FFmpeg, so it runs even on CFWs that ship no libmpv.

Features: search, Home/channel feeds, Community posts, playlists, Shorts, comments with replies, favorites, watch-later, history, SponsorBlock, quality/speed/volume controls, offline downloads, and casting to a linked device or Chromecast.

Requires a network connection.
attr.inst: Ready to run - no game files needed. Requires a Wi-Fi / network connection. All access is anonymous; no YouTube account or login is used.
attr.inst_md: Ready to run - no game files needed. Requires a **network connection**. All access is anonymous; no YouTube account or login is used.
